description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView component for displaying log data within an Android application. It implements the LogNode interface to receive and format log messages, converting priority levels into readable strings, and appending log details to the view.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received through the LogNode interface. It formats log data, handles thread-safe UI updates, and chains to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable. Converts priority to string, builds the output line, and updates the UI.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to the StringBuilder if it is not null or empty, adding a delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends the given string as a new line in the LogView.
